# Example Topology / Traffic Objective

Public IP:

198.51.100.20

Internal Web Server:

192.0.2.20

Public Service:

HTTPS TCP/443

WAN Interface:

ge-0/0/0.0

LAN Interface:

ge-0/0/1.0

WAN Zone:

untrust

LAN Zone:

trust

---

External clients connect to:

198.51.100.20 TCP/443

The SRX translates the destination to:

192.0.2.20 TCP/443

The traffic is then permitted by a security policy from:

untrust -> trust

---
